Interpolating 2019 wind data from copernicus

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(raster)
library(fields)

# read in shapefile 
wind_raw <- read_sf("./processed_evd/wind_data/Copernicus_era5_summary_wide.shp") 

# add eelgrass points df 

eelgrass_points <- read_sf("./shapefiles/PA_points_SDM/points_within_incl_attributes.shp")
res = 20
raster_extent <- ext(eelgrass_points)

# create an empty raster 
  empty_raster <-rast(
  extent = raster_extent,
  resolution = res,
  crs = "EPSG: 3725",
  vals = 1
  )
  
# extract xy from wind geometry
wind_xy <- st_coordinates(wind_raw$geometry)

wind_vect <- vect(wind_xy, crs = crs(wind_raw))
xy <- project(wind_vect, "EPSG:3725") 
xy <- as.data.frame(geom(xy)) %>% dplyr::select(x,y)

wind_raw_df <- as.data.frame(wind_raw)

# first column is id, last column is geometry
wind_raw_df <- wind_raw_df %>% 
  dplyr::select(-id, -geometry)

for (i in 1:ncol(wind_raw_df)) {
  
  print(i)
  v <- wind_raw_df[,i]

  tps <- Tps(xy, v)
  p <- rast(empty_raster)

  p <- interpolate(p, tps)

  # crop using land polygon 
  land_polygon <- vect("shapefiles/clipped_east_coast_2021_bdry.shp")
  land_polygon_projected <- land_polygon %>% 
    project("EPSG: 3725")

  cropped_rast <- mask(p, land_polygon_projected, inverse = TRUE)
  plot(cropped_rast)

  # write as raster and save
  writeRaster(cropped_rast, filename = sprintf("./processed_evd/environmental_layers/%s_wind_raster_20m_res_2019.tiff", colnames(wind_raw_df)[i]))
  
}


```
